profile.scope: Current Francis Kurkdjian edition launched in 2025.
profile.baseline_state: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE / ZERO EMPIRICAL SIMILARITY PASS
profile.official_summary: Dual iris from petal to rhizome; rhizome facets recall coffee and chocolate; dense patchouli, powerful vetiver and an overdose of coumarin with cut-hay dryness form the ambery accord.
profile.target_identity: A complete iris from aerial petal to dark rhizome, held against a firm patchouli-vetiver-coumarin amberwood base.
profile.authority_note: Official architecture only; proprietary molecular composition and dose remain unknown.

art_direction.primary_motif: A pale iris petal suspended above a black-violet rhizome.
art_direction.secondary_motif: Cut hay, vetiver and patchouli form a dry field compressed by a polished amberwood grip.
art_direction.foreground: Aerial iris, waxy root, hay dryness and bitter citrus-spice ignition.
art_direction.background: Coffee-cocoa darkness, smoke-thin incense, suede and mineral woods.
art_direction.release: The base does not simply crush the petal; it gradually turns petal into wax, wax into root, and root into polished dark wood.
art_direction.negative_space: Hedione, muguet air, magnolia and floral transmission leave a lit chamber above the dense base.
art_direction.recurrence: The petal disappears under patchouli at two hours, then reappears as a violet wax contour around the eight-hour woods.
art_direction.texture_progression: cold petal air → wax bloom → dark rhizome → cut hay → polished mineral wood
art_direction.spatial_identity: The far field is firm and woody; the near field retains floral wax and root detail.
art_direction.late_residue: Iris-root wax, vetiver, patchouli, hay and three-way amberwood pressure with a suede edge.
art_direction.controlled_imperfection: A trace of root earth, roasted grain and saffron-suede gives the immaculate structure a pulse.
art_direction.hedonic_hypothesis: The attraction is the sensation of fragility surviving force, not sweetness or brute projection.
layers: Bitter citrus, coriander, cardamom and aldehydes make a cold opening aperture.
Hedione, muguet, magnolia, rose/jasmine traces and mobile ionones form the tender petal.
Irone, orris product basis, Orivone, Irotyl, Koavone and dark floral traces create wax, root and coffee-like density.
Coumarin, hay absolute, cocoa, coffee and PADMA make dry shadow rather than dessert.
Patchouli, vetiver routes, cedar, incense and distributed amberwoods create a firm grip.
Musk polish, suede and ambergris materials preserve a waxy iris outline in the late residue.
hedonic_tuning: The petal block is intentionally large and internally diverse so it can survive a Parfum-strength base.
Three amberwood geometries share pressure to avoid a single scratchy ruler-straight drydown.
Coffee and cocoa are trace texture tools, never an edible accord.
Musk is subordinate polish; it cannot become the identity.

missing_chemical_impact.candidate: Iris pallida / orris absolute or concrete comparator with lot documentation
missing_chemical_impact.why_not_redundant: The current irone, ionone and product-basis iris system can model functions, but not establish the complete natural petal/rhizome texture or lot-specific minor constituents.
missing_chemical_impact.loss_if_omitted: The iris may read polished and abstract rather than simultaneously tender, rooty, coffee-dark and floral.
missing_chemical_impact.overdose_failure: Root mud, carrot, fatty wax or cosmetic lipstick can overwhelm petal air.
missing_chemical_impact.exact_comparison: Distributed synthetic iris system versus the same system plus natural comparator, with root and petal sub-block ablations at equal total load.
missing_chemical_impact.owned_functional_coverage: Alpha Irone 30%, Orivone, Irotyl, Koavone, ionones, Orris Liquid product basis
missing_chemical_impact.purchase_or_prepare: Acquire only a documented lot after the synthetic polarity screen identifies a persistent gap.

missing_chemical_impact.function: Petal survival under dense Parfum base
missing_chemical_impact.candidate: Measured headspace and coded temporal sensory data
missing_chemical_impact.why_not_redundant: A computational release model cannot prove that tender iris remains perceptible over patchouli, vetiver, coumarin and amberwoods.
missing_chemical_impact.loss_if_omitted: The build can become a dark woody-rhizome monolith.
missing_chemical_impact.overdose_failure: Not a purchase overdose; high base load can suppress petal detail.
missing_chemical_impact.exact_comparison: Full build versus −20% amberwood, −20% patchouli and +20% petal-air blocks; matched concentration, coded 5 min to 24 h testing.
missing_chemical_impact.purchase_or_prepare: Run evidence program before purchasing another iris material.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Bitter citrus/spice and aldehydes create a cold lit aperture for the petal.
interaction_map.failure_mode: Harsh cold top or cosmetic soap.

interaction_map.expected_effect: The two iris poles form one complete flower-root object.
interaction_map.failure_mode: Stacked floral and muddy root modules.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Hay and coumarin dry the wax and amplify coffee/chocolate associations without food literalness.
interaction_map.failure_mode: Dusty attic, carrot earth or cocoa dessert.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Patchouli deepens root darkness and connects iris to earth.
Vetiver supplies dry tensile contrast but may suppress the tender petal.
interaction_map.physical_test: Matched −20%/+20% vetiver test at 30 min, 2 h, 8 h.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Distributed amberwoods create firm projection while allowing a wax contour to survive.
interaction_map.physical_test: Three-way amberwood ratio perturbation; blind preference and petal recognition.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Soft clean musks polish pressure edges without becoming a laundry chassis.
interaction_map.failure_mode: Laundry flattening and loss of root grain.

interaction_map.expected_effect: The desired recurrence is petal transformed into a wax ring around late woods.
interaction_map.physical_test: Time-course 5 min to 24 h with unified-iris score.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Musk may convert root wax into skin-like mineral suede.
interaction_map.physical_test: 8 h and 24 h residue triangle/paired comparison.

test_plan.primary_comparison: Full Petal Under Pressure versus petal-only, rhizome-only, no-pressure, and −20% pressure-base controls.
pass_criteria: unified iris stronger than either pole alone
test_plan.reference_gate: Current 2025 reference bottle required for similarity.

temporal_test.replication: Two non-consecutive days; matched application geometry
temporal_test.core_time_question: Does tender petal remain legible while rhizome and ambery grip intensify?
temporal_test.instrumental_lane: HS-SPME-GC-MS at 0/30 min/2 h/8 h on sealed vial and blotter; static and dynamic data remain separate
temporal_test.sensory_lane: Coded descriptive time-intensity plus hard-defect checklist
temporal_test.thermodynamic_inputs: Exact stock amounts, ethanol/water matrix, temperature, substrate, dose area, vapor pressure, activity-coefficient model/version
